entry.summary: No prior clearance for a visit of 14 days or less arriving and leaving on the same vessel, if you can support yourself. Longer stays need entry clearance in advance.
entry.max_stay: 14 days without clearance; up to 6 months with long-term entry clearance (NZ$150, about A$120 at RBA, 30 October 2026: A$1 = NZ$1.2480; apply at least 3 months ahead)
entry.other: Business visits follow the entry clearance procedure. Landing depends on sea conditions and the supply ship or yacht; there is no guarantee of landing.

layers.process: For stays over 14 days, or business visits, send the entry clearance form to the Pitcairn Islands Office before booking passage.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: No FCDO advice page exists for Pitcairn Islands, and no official etiquette guidance has been checked yet. Ask locally. Visit Pitcairn: observe the Saturday Sabbath, dress tidily for church, and don't drink alcohol in public areas (roads, the Landing, the Public Square).
